en-US.Title: Title
en-US.Assemble interlocking pieces into a pict: Assemble interlocking pieces into a picture on the gallery desk — snapping, trays, rotation and optional hints.
One shared mosaic per UTC day — ranked.
en-US.Interactive lessons — one rule at a time: Interactive lessons — one rule at a time. ~3 min.
en-US.40 authored stages with growing mechanic: 40 authored stages with growing mechanics. Ranked progression.
en-US.Shared seed per UTC day. Ranked, no undo: Shared seed per UTC day. Ranked, no undo.
en-US.Your difficulty, restart and undo, never: Your difficulty, restart and undo, never ranked.
en-US.Move limits, speed targets, altered layo: Move limits, speed targets, altered layouts.
en-US.Each lesson introduces one rule and asks: Each lesson introduces one rule and asks you to perform it.
en-US.Relaxed play: restart and undo allowed,: Relaxed play: restart and undo allowed, never ranked.
en-US.This is the gallery desk. The mosaic abo: This is the gallery desk. The mosaic above the tray is your goal image.
en-US.Select a piece from the tray below (clic: Select a piece from the tray below (click, tap, or arrow keys + Enter).
en-US.Now choose a glowing cell on the board t: Now choose a glowing cell on the board to place it. Pieces snap into place.
en-US.Place the remaining pieces to finish the: Place the remaining pieces to finish the picture.
en-US.Some pieces arrive turned. A piece only: Some pieces arrive turned. A piece only snaps when upright.
en-US.Select a turned piece, then rotate it wi: Select a turned piece, then rotate it with R, the Rotate button, or a double-tap.
Now place it on its matching cell.
en-US.Stuck? Press H or the Hint button and th: Stuck? Press H or the Hint button and the gallery shows one legal move.
en-US.Use a hint now. Hints cost score but nev: Use a hint now. Hints cost score but never block completion.
en-US.You can undo a placement with U. Try fin: You can undo a placement with U. Try finishing the mosaic.
en-US.Finish a 4x4 with no wasted moves. No un: Finish a 4x4 with no wasted moves. No undo.
en-US.Finish a 4x4 rotation puzzle in 3 minute: Finish a 4x4 rotation puzzle in 3 minutes.
Complete a rotation stage without hints.
en-US.Spend 60 total minutes in the gallery (a: Spend 60 total minutes in the gallery (any assists).
en-US.One shared seed for all players today. R: One shared seed for all players today. Ranked; no undo.
en-US.Restart and undo freely; no effect on ra: Restart and undo freely; no effect on ratings.
en-US.{mode}. {n} pieces. Select a piece from: {mode}. {n} pieces. Select a piece from the tray to begin.
en-US.{mode}: place all {n} pieces on the {col: {mode}: place all {n} pieces on the {cols}×{rows} board.
Pieces must be upright (rotate with R).
That cell is off the board.
en-US.The piece must be upright first — rotate: The piece must be upright first — rotate it with R.
en-US.Nothing to undo (or undo is disabled in: Nothing to undo (or undo is disabled in this ranked mode).
The picture hangs on the gallery wall.
en-US.Sort the tray pieces, read the edge colo: Sort the tray pieces, read the edge colors and glyphs, and drag each piece onto its matching board cell. Pieces snap when legal. Complete connected groups to finish the picture.
en-US.<strong>Pointer / touch:</strong> tap a: Pointer / touch: tap a piece to select, tap a glowing cell to place. Drag pieces directly. Double-tap a piece to rotate.
en-US.Tab reaches the tray and board lists, {a: Tab reaches the tray and board lists, {arrows} move within them, Enter selects a piece or places it, {rotate} rotates, {hint} hints, {undo} undoes, {pause} pauses, {camera} resets the camera. {picks} pick the 1st–9th tray piece.
en-US.Every action gives immediate visual and: Every action gives immediate visual and sonic feedback; illegal targets explain why.
en-US.+100 per placed piece, completion and ef: +100 per placed piece, completion and efficiency bonuses; hints, undos and invalid actions cost points. Time is tracked separately so relaxed play stays valid.
en-US.Signed in as <strong>{name}</strong> — p: Signed in as {name} — progress syncs to your account (status sits next to the clock).
en-US.Playing as <strong>{name}</strong> (loca: Playing as {name} (local guest profile; sign-in is offered by the host shell).
No entries yet — be the first.
en-US.No platform leaderboard for this game —: No platform leaderboard for this game — showing personal bests only.
en-US.While you were away your round was pause: While you were away your round was paused. You had placed {n}/{total} pieces in {time}.
en-US.Volumes and mute are in the StarHermit O: Volumes and mute are in the StarHermit Options.
en-US.Sound, graphics, language, reduced motio: Sound, graphics, language, reduced motion, high contrast and larger text are in the StarHermit Options.
en-US.With nothing focused, the arrows move a: With nothing focused, the arrows move a cursor over the board and {place} places the selected piece there (or picks the next tray piece).
en-US.acct.signInSub: Sync progress and settings to your account.

es-419.Title: Inicio
es-419.Assemble interlocking pieces into a pict: Arma una imagen con piezas encajables en la mesa de la galería: encaje automático, bandejas, giros y pistas opcionales.
Un mosaico compartido por día UTC, con clasificación.
es-419.Interactive lessons — one rule at a time: Lecciones interactivas: una regla a la vez. ~3 min.
es-419.40 authored stages with growing mechanic: 40 etapas diseñadas con mecánicas crecientes. Progreso clasificatorio.
es-419.Shared seed per UTC day. Ranked, no undo: Semilla compartida por día UTC. Clasificatorio, sin deshacer.
es-419.Your difficulty, restart and undo, never: Tu dificultad, reinicio y deshacer, nunca clasificatorio.
es-419.Move limits, speed targets, altered layo: Límites de movimientos, metas de velocidad, diseños alterados.
Comparación de puntuaciones global y con amigos.
es-419.Each lesson introduces one rule and asks: Cada lección presenta una regla y te pide aplicarla.
es-419.{done}/{total} complete. ★ marks mastery: {done}/{total} completadas. ★ marca las etapas de maestría.
es-419.Relaxed play: restart and undo allowed,: Juego relajado: reiniciar y deshacer permitidos, nunca clasificatorio.
es-419.This is the gallery desk. The mosaic abo: Esta es la mesa de la galería. El mosaico sobre la bandeja es tu imagen objetivo.
es-419.Select a piece from the tray below (clic: Elige una pieza de la bandeja de abajo (clic, toque o flechas + Intro).
es-419.Now choose a glowing cell on the board t: Ahora elige una casilla iluminada del tablero para colocarla. Las piezas encajan solas.
es-419.Place the remaining pieces to finish the: Coloca las piezas restantes para terminar la imagen.
es-419.Some pieces arrive turned. A piece only: Algunas piezas llegan giradas. Una pieza solo encaja si está derecha.
es-419.Select a turned piece, then rotate it wi: Elige una pieza girada y gírala con R, el botón Girar o un doble toque.
Ahora colócala en su casilla correspondiente.
es-419.Stuck? Press H or the Hint button and th: ¿Atascado? Pulsa H o el botón Pista y la galería te muestra un movimiento válido.
es-419.Use a hint now. Hints cost score but nev: Usa una pista ahora. Las pistas restan puntos pero nunca impiden terminar.
es-419.You can undo a placement with U. Try fin: Puedes deshacer una colocación con U. Intenta terminar el mosaico.
es-419.Finish a 4x4 with no wasted moves. No un: Termina un 4×4 sin desperdiciar movimientos. Sin deshacer.
es-419.Finish a 4x4 rotation puzzle in 3 minute: Termina un puzle 4×4 con giros en 3 minutos.
Un diseño alterado y ancho de 8×4.
Completa una etapa con giros sin pistas.
es-419.Spend 60 total minutes in the gallery (a: Pasa 60 minutos en total en la galería (con cualquier ayuda).
es-419.One shared seed for all players today. R: Una semilla compartida por todos hoy. Clasificatorio; sin deshacer.
es-419.Yes — platform board (read-only): Sí: clasificación de la plataforma (solo lectura)
es-419.Restart and undo freely; no effect on ra: Reinicia y deshaz libremente; no afecta a las clasificaciones.
es-419.{mode}. {n} pieces. Select a piece from: {mode}. {n} piezas. Elige una pieza de la bandeja para empezar.
es-419.{mode}: place all {n} pieces on the {col: {mode}: coloca las {n} piezas en el tablero de {cols}×{rows}.
Las piezas deben estar derechas (gira con R).
Esa casilla está fuera del tablero.
es-419.The piece must be upright first — rotate: Primero la pieza debe estar derecha: gírala con R.
es-419.Nothing to undo (or undo is disabled in: No hay nada que deshacer (o deshacer está desactivado en este modo clasificatorio).
Primero elige una pieza de la bandeja.
La imagen ya cuelga en la pared de la galería.
es-419.Tiles matching the goal image: Fichas que coinciden con la imagen objetivo
es-419.Sort the tray pieces, read the edge colo: Ordena las piezas de la bandeja, fíjate en los colores y símbolos de los bordes y arrastra cada pieza a su casilla. Las piezas encajan si el lugar es válido. Completa grupos conectados para terminar la imagen.
es-419.<strong>Pointer / touch:</strong> tap a: Puntero / táctil: toca una pieza para elegirla y una casilla iluminada para colocarla. También puedes arrastrar piezas. Doble toque para girar.
es-419.Tab reaches the tray and board lists, {a: Tab llega a las listas de bandeja y tablero, {arrows} te mueven en ellas, Intro elige o coloca una pieza, {rotate} gira, {hint} da una pista, {undo} deshace, {pause} pausa, {camera} restablece la cámara. {picks} eligen la 1.ª a 9.ª pieza de la bandeja.
es-419.Every action gives immediate visual and: Cada acción da respuesta visual y sonora inmediata; los destinos no válidos explican por qué.
es-419.+100 per placed piece, completion and ef: +100 por pieza colocada, más bonificaciones por terminar y por eficiencia; pistas, deshacer y acciones no válidas restan puntos. El tiempo se registra aparte, así que jugar con calma también vale.
es-419.Timing assistance (double time limits): Ayuda de tiempo (doble límite de tiempo)
es-419.Signed in as <strong>{name}</strong> — p: Sesión iniciada como {name}: el progreso se sincroniza con tu cuenta (el estado está junto al reloj).
es-419.Playing as <strong>{name}</strong> (loca: Jugando como {name} (perfil local de invitado; el inicio de sesión lo ofrece la plataforma).
Aún no hay entradas: sé el primero.
Tu mejor marca en la plataforma: {n}.
es-419.No platform leaderboard for this game —: Este juego no tiene clasificación en la plataforma: solo se muestran tus récords.
es-419.While you were away your round was pause: Mientras no estabas, tu ronda quedó en pausa. Habías colocado {n}/{total} piezas en {time}.
es-419.Volumes and mute are in the StarHermit O: El volumen y el silencio están en las Opciones de StarHermit.
es-419.Sound, graphics, language, reduced motio: El sonido, los gráficos, el idioma, el movimiento reducido, el alto contraste y el texto más grande están en las Opciones de StarHermit.
es-419.With nothing focused, the arrows move a: Sin nada enfocado, las flechas mueven un cursor por el tablero y {place} coloca allí la pieza seleccionada (o toma la siguiente pieza de la bandeja).
es-419.acct.signInSub: Sincroniza tu progreso y ajustes con tu cuenta.

de-DE.Title: Start
de-DE.Assemble interlocking pieces into a pict: Setze ineinandergreifende Teile auf dem Galerietisch zu einem Bild zusammen – mit Einrasten, Ablagen, Drehen und optionalen Tipps.
Ein gemeinsames Mosaik pro UTC-Tag – gewertet.
de-DE.Interactive lessons — one rule at a time: Interaktive Lektionen – eine Regel nach der anderen. ~3 Min.
de-DE.40 authored stages with growing mechanic: 40 gestaltete Etappen mit wachsenden Mechaniken. Gewerteter Fortschritt.
de-DE.Shared seed per UTC day. Ranked, no undo: Gemeinsamer Seed pro UTC-Tag. Gewertet, ohne Rückgängig.
de-DE.Your difficulty, restart and undo, never: Deine Schwierigkeit, Neustart und Rückgängig, nie gewertet.
de-DE.Each lesson introduces one rule and asks: Jede Lektion stellt eine Regel vor und lässt sie dich ausführen.
de-DE.Relaxed play: restart and undo allowed,: Entspanntes Spiel: Neustart und Rückgängig erlaubt, nie gewertet.
de-DE.This is the gallery desk. The mosaic abo: Das ist der Galerietisch. Das Mosaik über der Ablage ist dein Zielbild.
de-DE.Select a piece from the tray below (clic: Wähle ein Teil aus der Ablage unten (Klick, Tippen oder Pfeiltasten + Eingabe).
de-DE.Now choose a glowing cell on the board t: Wähle jetzt ein leuchtendes Feld auf dem Brett, um es zu setzen. Teile rasten ein.
de-DE.Place the remaining pieces to finish the: Setze die übrigen Teile, um das Bild fertigzustellen.
de-DE.Some pieces arrive turned. A piece only: Manche Teile kommen gedreht an. Ein Teil rastet nur aufrecht ein.
de-DE.Select a turned piece, then rotate it wi: Wähle ein gedrehtes Teil und drehe es mit R, der Schaltfläche „Drehen“ oder Doppeltippen.
Setze es jetzt auf sein passendes Feld.
de-DE.Stuck? Press H or the Hint button and th: Festgefahren? Drück H oder „Tipp“, und die Galerie zeigt einen gültigen Zug.
de-DE.Use a hint now. Hints cost score but nev: Nutze jetzt einen Tipp. Tipps kosten Punkte, verhindern aber nie den Abschluss.
de-DE.You can undo a placement with U. Try fin: Mit U machst du ein Setzen rückgängig. Versuch, das Mosaik fertigzustellen.
de-DE.Finish a 4x4 with no wasted moves. No un: Löse ein 4×4 ohne verschwendete Züge. Ohne Rückgängig.
Stelle an 3 verschiedenen Tagen Mosaike fertig.
de-DE.Spend 60 total minutes in the gallery (a: Verbringe insgesamt 60 Minuten in der Galerie (beliebige Hilfen).
de-DE.One shared seed for all players today. R: Ein gemeinsamer Seed für alle heute. Gewertet; ohne Rückgängig.
de-DE.Restart and undo freely; no effect on ra: Neustart und Rückgängig nach Belieben; kein Einfluss auf Wertungen.
de-DE.{mode}. {n} pieces. Select a piece from: {mode}. {n} Teile. Wähle ein Teil aus der Ablage, um zu beginnen.
Teile müssen aufrecht stehen (mit R drehen).
Dieses Feld liegt außerhalb des Bretts.
de-DE.The piece must be upright first — rotate: Das Teil muss erst aufrecht stehen – dreh es mit R.
de-DE.Nothing to undo (or undo is disabled in: Nichts rückgängig zu machen (oder Rückgängig ist in diesem gewerteten Modus aus).
Wähle zuerst ein Teil aus der Ablage.
Das Bild hängt an der Galeriewand.
de-DE.Sort the tray pieces, read the edge colo: Sortiere die Teile, achte auf Randfarben und Symbole und zieh jedes Teil auf sein passendes Feld. Gültig gesetzte Teile rasten ein. Vervollständige zusammenhängende Gruppen, um das Bild fertigzustellen.
de-DE.<strong>Pointer / touch:</strong> tap a: Maus / Touch: Teil antippen zum Auswählen, leuchtendes Feld antippen zum Setzen. Teile direkt ziehen. Doppeltippen dreht ein Teil.
de-DE.Tab reaches the tray and board lists, {a: Tab erreicht Ablage- und Brettlisten, {arrows} bewegen sich darin, Eingabe wählt oder setzt ein Teil, {rotate} dreht, {hint} gibt einen Tipp, {undo} macht rückgängig, {pause} pausiert, {camera} setzt die Kamera zurück. {picks} wählen das 1.–9. Teil der Ablage.
de-DE.Every action gives immediate visual and: Jede Aktion gibt sofort Bild- und Tonrückmeldung; ungültige Ziele erklären den Grund.
de-DE.+100 per placed piece, completion and ef: +100 pro gesetztem Teil, Abschluss- und Effizienzbonus; Tipps, Rückgängig und ungültige Aktionen kosten Punkte. Die Zeit wird getrennt erfasst, entspanntes Spielen zählt also auch.
de-DE.Signed in as <strong>{name}</strong> — p: Angemeldet als {name} – der Fortschritt wird mit deinem Konto synchronisiert (Status neben der Uhr).
de-DE.Playing as <strong>{name}</strong> (loca: Du spielst als {name} (lokales Gastprofil; die Anmeldung bietet die Plattform an).
Noch keine Einträge – sei der Erste.
de-DE.No platform leaderboard for this game —: Für dieses Spiel gibt es keine Plattform-Bestenliste – nur persönliche Rekorde.
de-DE.While you were away your round was pause: Während du weg warst, war deine Runde pausiert. Du hattest {n}/{total} Teile in {time} gesetzt.
de-DE.Volumes and mute are in the StarHermit O: Lautstärke und Stummschaltung findest du in den StarHermit-Optionen.
de-DE.Sound, graphics, language, reduced motio: Ton, Grafik, Sprache, reduzierte Bewegung, hoher Kontrast und größerer Text findest du in den StarHermit-Optionen.
de-DE.With nothing focused, the arrows move a: Ist nichts fokussiert, bewegen die Pfeiltasten einen Cursor über das Brett, und {place} setzt das gewählte Teil dorthin (oder nimmt das nächste Teil aus der Ablage).
de-DE.acct.signInSub: Fortschritt und Einstellungen mit deinem Konto synchronisieren.

fr-FR.Save sync status: État de synchronisation de la sauvegarde
fr-FR.Title: Accueil
fr-FR.Assemble interlocking pieces into a pict: Assemblez des pièces imbriquées en une image sur la table de la galerie — aimantation, plateaux, rotation et indices facultatifs.
Une mosaïque partagée par jour UTC — classée.
fr-FR.Interactive lessons — one rule at a time: Leçons interactives — une règle à la fois. ~3 min.
fr-FR.40 authored stages with growing mechanic: 40 étapes conçues aux mécaniques croissantes. Progression classée.
fr-FR.Shared seed per UTC day. Ranked, no undo: Graine partagée par jour UTC. Classé, sans annulation.
fr-FR.Your difficulty, restart and undo, never: Votre difficulté, redémarrage et annulation, jamais classé.
fr-FR.Move limits, speed targets, altered layo: Coups limités, objectifs de vitesse, dispositions modifiées.
Comparaison des scores mondiale et entre amis.
fr-FR.Each lesson introduces one rule and asks: Chaque leçon présente une règle et vous demande de l’appliquer.
fr-FR.{done}/{total} complete. ★ marks mastery: {done}/{total} terminées. ★ indique les étapes de maîtrise.
fr-FR.Relaxed play: restart and undo allowed,: Jeu détendu : redémarrage et annulation permis, jamais classé.
fr-FR.This is the gallery desk. The mosaic abo: Voici la table de la galerie. La mosaïque au-dessus du plateau de tri est votre modèle.
fr-FR.Select a piece from the tray below (clic: Choisissez une pièce ci-dessous (clic, toucher ou flèches + Entrée).
fr-FR.Now choose a glowing cell on the board t: Choisissez maintenant une case lumineuse du plateau pour la poser. Les pièces s’aimantent.
fr-FR.Place the remaining pieces to finish the: Posez les pièces restantes pour terminer l’image.
fr-FR.Some pieces arrive turned. A piece only: Certaines pièces arrivent tournées. Une pièce ne s’aimante que droite.
fr-FR.Select a turned piece, then rotate it wi: Choisissez une pièce tournée, puis faites-la pivoter avec R, le bouton Pivoter ou un double toucher.
Posez-la maintenant sur sa case correspondante.
fr-FR.Stuck? Press H or the Hint button and th: Bloqué ? Appuyez sur H ou sur Indice et la galerie montre un coup possible.
fr-FR.Use a hint now. Hints cost score but nev: Utilisez un indice maintenant. Les indices coûtent des points mais n’empêchent jamais de finir.
fr-FR.You can undo a placement with U. Try fin: Vous pouvez annuler une pose avec U. Essayez de terminer la mosaïque.
fr-FR.Finish a 4x4 with no wasted moves. No un: Terminez un 4×4 sans coup perdu. Sans annulation.
fr-FR.Finish a 4x4 rotation puzzle in 3 minute: Terminez un puzzle 4×4 avec rotation en 3 minutes.
Terminez une étape avec rotation sans indice.
fr-FR.Spend 60 total minutes in the gallery (a: Passez 60 minutes au total dans la galerie (toutes aides).
fr-FR.One shared seed for all players today. R: Une graine partagée par tous aujourd’hui. Classé ; sans annulation.
fr-FR.Yes — platform board (read-only): Oui — classement de la plateforme (lecture seule)
fr-FR.Restart and undo freely; no effect on ra: Redémarrez et annulez librement ; aucun effet sur les classements.
fr-FR.{mode}. {n} pieces. Select a piece from: {mode}. {n} pièces. Choisissez une pièce pour commencer.
fr-FR.{mode}: place all {n} pieces on the {col: {mode} : posez les {n} pièces sur le plateau {cols}×{rows}.
Les pièces doivent être droites (pivotez avec R).
Cette case est hors du plateau.
fr-FR.The piece must be upright first — rotate: La pièce doit d’abord être droite — pivotez-la avec R.
fr-FR.Nothing to undo (or undo is disabled in: Rien à annuler (ou l’annulation est désactivée dans ce mode classé).
fr-FR.Piece {n} selected. {cells} legal cells: Pièce {n} choisie. {cells} cases possibles en surbrillance.
L’image est accrochée au mur de la galerie.
fr-FR.Sort the tray pieces, read the edge colo: Triez les pièces, lisez les couleurs et symboles des bords, puis faites glisser chaque pièce sur sa case. Les pièces s’aimantent quand c’est permis. Complétez les groupes reliés pour terminer l’image.
fr-FR.<strong>Pointer / touch:</strong> tap a: Souris / tactile : touchez une pièce pour la choisir, puis une case lumineuse pour la poser. Faites glisser les pièces directement. Double-touchez pour pivoter.
fr-FR.Tab reaches the tray and board lists, {a: Tab atteint les listes des pièces et du plateau, {arrows} s’y déplacent, Entrée choisit ou pose une pièce, {rotate} pivote, {hint} donne un indice, {undo} annule, {pause} met en pause, {camera} recentre la caméra. {picks} choisissent la 1re à la 9e pièce.
fr-FR.Every action gives immediate visual and: Chaque action donne un retour visuel et sonore immédiat ; les cibles interdites expliquent pourquoi.
fr-FR.+100 per placed piece, completion and ef: +100 par pièce posée, bonus d’achèvement et d’efficacité ; indices, annulations et actions invalides coûtent des points. Le temps est compté à part : jouer tranquillement reste valable.
fr-FR.Signed in as <strong>{name}</strong> — p: Connecté en tant que {name} — la progression se synchronise avec votre compte (l’état est à côté de l’horloge).
fr-FR.Playing as <strong>{name}</strong> (loca: Vous jouez en tant que {name} (profil invité local ; la connexion est proposée par la plateforme).
Pas encore d’entrées — soyez le premier.
fr-FR.No platform leaderboard for this game —: Aucun classement de plateforme pour ce jeu — records personnels uniquement.
fr-FR.Chase best: Record de la course au score
fr-FR.While you were away your round was pause: Pendant votre absence, votre manche était en pause. Vous aviez posé {n}/{total} pièces en {time}.
fr-FR.Volumes and mute are in the StarHermit O: Le volume et la sourdine se trouvent dans les Options StarHermit.
fr-FR.Sound, graphics, language, reduced motio: Le son, les graphismes, la langue, les animations réduites, le contraste élevé et le texte agrandi se trouvent dans les Options StarHermit.
fr-FR.With nothing focused, the arrows move a: Quand rien n’a le focus, les flèches déplacent un curseur sur le plateau et {place} y pose la pièce sélectionnée (ou prend la pièce suivante en attente).
fr-FR.acct.signInSub: Synchronisez progression et réglages avec votre compte.

pt-BR.Title: Início

Um mosaico compartilhado por dia UTC — ranqueado.
pt-BR.Interactive lessons — one rule at a time: Lições interativas — uma regra de cada vez. ~3 min.
pt-BR.40 authored stages with growing mechanic: 40 etapas criadas com mecânicas crescentes. Progresso ranqueado.
pt-BR.Shared seed per UTC day. Ranked, no undo: Semente compartilhada por dia UTC. Ranqueado, sem desfazer.
pt-BR.Your difficulty, restart and undo, never: Sua dificuldade, reiniciar e desfazer, nunca ranqueado.
pt-BR.Move limits, speed targets, altered layo: Limite de jogadas, metas de velocidade, layouts alterados.
Comparação de pontuações global e com amigos.
pt-BR.Each lesson introduces one rule and asks: Cada lição apresenta uma regra e pede que você a execute.
pt-BR.{done}/{total} complete. ★ marks mastery: {done}/{total} concluídas. ★ marca as etapas de maestria.
pt-BR.Relaxed play: restart and undo allowed,: Jogo tranquilo: reiniciar e desfazer permitidos, nunca ranqueado.

pt-BR.Some pieces arrive turned. A piece only: Algumas peças chegam viradas. Uma peça só encaixa quando está em pé.
pt-BR.Select a turned piece, then rotate it wi: Escolha uma peça virada e gire-a com R, o botão Girar ou um toque duplo.
pt-BR.Stuck? Press H or the Hint button and th: Travou? Pressione H ou o botão Dica e a galeria mostra uma jogada válida.
pt-BR.Use a hint now. Hints cost score but nev: Use uma dica agora. Dicas custam pontos, mas nunca impedem a conclusão.
pt-BR.You can undo a placement with U. Try fin: Você pode desfazer uma colocação com U. Tente terminar o mosaico.
pt-BR.Finish a 4x4 with no wasted moves. No un: Termine um 4×4 sem desperdiçar jogadas. Sem desfazer.
pt-BR.Finish a 4x4 rotation puzzle in 3 minute: Termine um quebra-cabeça 4×4 com rotação em 3 minutos.
Um layout alterado e largo de 8×4.
Conclua uma etapa com rotação sem dicas.
pt-BR.Spend 60 total minutes in the gallery (a: Passe 60 minutos no total na galeria (qualquer ajuda).
pt-BR.One shared seed for all players today. R: Uma semente compartilhada por todos hoje. Ranqueado; sem desfazer.
pt-BR.Restart and undo freely; no effect on ra: Reinicie e desfaça à vontade; sem efeito nas classificações.
pt-BR.{mode}. {n} pieces. Select a piece from: {mode}. {n} peças. Escolha uma peça da bandeja para começar.
As peças precisam estar em pé (gire com R).
Essa casa está fora do tabuleiro.
pt-BR.The piece must be upright first — rotate: A peça precisa estar em pé antes — gire-a com R.
pt-BR.Nothing to undo (or undo is disabled in: Nada para desfazer (ou desfazer está desativado neste modo ranqueado).
Escolha primeiro uma peça da bandeja.
A imagem está pendurada na parede da galeria.
pt-BR.Tiles matching the goal image: Ladrilhos que correspondem à imagem objetivo
pt-BR.Sort the tray pieces, read the edge colo: Organize as peças, observe as cores e os símbolos das bordas e arraste cada peça para a casa correspondente. As peças encaixam quando a jogada é válida. Complete grupos conectados para terminar a imagem.
pt-BR.<strong>Pointer / touch:</strong> tap a: Ponteiro / toque: toque numa peça para escolher e numa casa iluminada para colocar. Arraste as peças diretamente. Toque duplo para girar.
pt-BR.Tab reaches the tray and board lists, {a: Tab chega às listas da bandeja e do tabuleiro, {arrows} movem nelas, Enter escolhe ou coloca uma peça, {rotate} gira, {hint} dá uma dica, {undo} desfaz, {pause} pausa, {camera} reposiciona a câmera. {picks} escolhem da 1.ª à 9.ª peça da bandeja.
pt-BR.Every action gives immediate visual and: Toda ação dá retorno visual e sonoro imediato; destinos inválidos explicam o motivo.
pt-BR.+100 per placed piece, completion and ef: +100 por peça colocada, bônus de conclusão e de eficiência; dicas, desfazer e ações inválidas custam pontos. O tempo é medido à parte, então jogar com calma também vale.
pt-BR.Signed in as <strong>{name}</strong> — p: Conectado como {name} — o progresso é sincronizado com sua conta (o status fica ao lado do relógio).
pt-BR.Playing as <strong>{name}</strong> (loca: Jogando como {name} (perfil local de convidado; o login é oferecido pela plataforma).
Ainda sem entradas — seja o primeiro.
pt-BR.No platform leaderboard for this game —: Este jogo não tem ranking na plataforma — mostrando só recordes pessoais.
pt-BR.While you were away your round was pause: Enquanto você estava fora, sua rodada ficou pausada. Você tinha colocado {n}/{total} peças em {time}.
pt-BR.Volumes and mute are in the StarHermit O: Volume e mudo ficam nas Opções do StarHermit.
pt-BR.Sound, graphics, language, reduced motio: Som, gráficos, idioma, movimento reduzido, alto contraste e texto maior ficam nas Opções do StarHermit.
pt-BR.With nothing focused, the arrows move a: Sem nada em foco, as setas movem um cursor pelo tabuleiro e {place} coloca ali a peça selecionada (ou pega a próxima peça da bandeja).
pt-BR.acct.signInSub: Sincronize progresso e configurações com sua conta.

it-IT.Title: Inizio
it-IT.Assemble interlocking pieces into a pict: Componi un’immagine con pezzi a incastro sul tavolo della galleria: aggancio, vassoi, rotazione e aiuti facoltativi.
Un mosaico condiviso per giorno UTC, in classifica.
it-IT.Interactive lessons — one rule at a time: Lezioni interattive: una regola alla volta. ~3 min.
it-IT.40 authored stages with growing mechanic: 40 tappe d’autore con meccaniche crescenti. Progressione in classifica.
it-IT.Shared seed per UTC day. Ranked, no undo: Seme condiviso per giorno UTC. In classifica, senza annulla.
it-IT.Your difficulty, restart and undo, never: La tua difficoltà, ricomincia e annulla, mai in classifica.
it-IT.Move limits, speed targets, altered layo: Mosse limitate, obiettivi di velocità, disposizioni alterate.
Confronto dei punteggi globale e con gli amici.
it-IT.Each lesson introduces one rule and asks: Ogni lezione introduce una regola e ti chiede di applicarla.
it-IT.{done}/{total} complete. ★ marks mastery: {done}/{total} completate. ★ indica le tappe di maestria.
it-IT.Relaxed play: restart and undo allowed,: Gioco rilassato: ricomincia e annulla consentiti, mai in classifica.
it-IT.This is the gallery desk. The mosaic abo: Questo è il tavolo della galleria. Il mosaico sopra il vassoio è l’immagine da ottenere.
it-IT.Select a piece from the tray below (clic: Scegli un pezzo dal vassoio qui sotto (clic, tocco o frecce + Invio).
it-IT.Now choose a glowing cell on the board t: Ora scegli una cella illuminata del tabellone per posarlo. I pezzi si agganciano.
it-IT.Place the remaining pieces to finish the: Posa i pezzi rimanenti per finire l’immagine.
it-IT.Some pieces arrive turned. A piece only: Alcuni pezzi arrivano ruotati. Un pezzo si aggancia solo se è diritto.
it-IT.Select a turned piece, then rotate it wi: Scegli un pezzo ruotato e giralo con R, il pulsante Ruota o un doppio tocco.
it-IT.Stuck? Press H or the Hint button and th: Bloccato? Premi H o il pulsante Aiuto e la galleria mostra una mossa valida.
it-IT.Use a hint now. Hints cost score but nev: Usa un aiuto ora. Gli aiuti costano punti ma non impediscono mai di finire.
it-IT.You can undo a placement with U. Try fin: Puoi annullare una posa con U. Prova a completare il mosaico.
it-IT.Finish a 4x4 with no wasted moves. No un: Completa un 4×4 senza mosse sprecate. Senza annulla.
it-IT.Finish a 4x4 rotation puzzle in 3 minute: Completa un puzzle 4×4 con rotazione in 3 minuti.
Una disposizione alterata e ampia di 8×4.
Completa una tappa con rotazione senza aiuti.
it-IT.Spend 60 total minutes in the gallery (a: Trascorri 60 minuti in totale nella galleria (qualsiasi aiuto).
it-IT.One shared seed for all players today. R: Un seme condiviso da tutti oggi. In classifica; senza annulla.
it-IT.Restart and undo freely; no effect on ra: Ricomincia e annulla liberamente; nessun effetto sulle classifiche.
it-IT.{mode}. {n} pieces. Select a piece from: {mode}. {n} pezzi. Scegli un pezzo dal vassoio per iniziare.
it-IT.{mode}: place all {n} pieces on the {col: {mode}: posa tutti i {n} pezzi sul tabellone {cols}×{rows}.
I pezzi devono essere diritti (ruota con R).
Quella cella è fuori dal tabellone.
it-IT.The piece must be upright first — rotate: Prima il pezzo deve essere diritto: ruotalo con R.
it-IT.Nothing to undo (or undo is disabled in: Niente da annullare (o annulla è disattivato in questa modalità in classifica).
Scegli prima un pezzo dal vassoio.
L’immagine è appesa alla parete della galleria.
it-IT.Sort the tray pieces, read the edge colo: Ordina i pezzi, leggi colori e simboli dei bordi e trascina ogni pezzo sulla sua cella. I pezzi si agganciano se la posa è valida. Completa i gruppi collegati per finire l’immagine.
it-IT.<strong>Pointer / touch:</strong> tap a: Puntatore / touch: tocca un pezzo per sceglierlo e una cella illuminata per posarlo. Trascina i pezzi direttamente. Doppio tocco per ruotare.
it-IT.Tab reaches the tray and board lists, {a: Tab raggiunge gli elenchi di vassoio e tabellone, {arrows} si muovono al loro interno, Invio sceglie o posa un pezzo, {rotate} ruota, {hint} dà un aiuto, {undo} annulla, {pause} mette in pausa, {camera} ripristina la visuale. {picks} scelgono dal 1° al 9° pezzo del vassoio.
it-IT.Every action gives immediate visual and: Ogni azione dà un riscontro visivo e sonoro immediato; le destinazioni non valide spiegano il motivo.
it-IT.+100 per placed piece, completion and ef: +100 per pezzo posato, bonus di completamento ed efficienza; aiuti, annullamenti e azioni non valide costano punti. Il tempo è contato a parte, quindi giocare con calma resta valido.
it-IT.Signed in as <strong>{name}</strong> — p: Accesso come {name}: i progressi si sincronizzano con il tuo account (lo stato è accanto all’orologio).
it-IT.Playing as <strong>{name}</strong> (loca: Giochi come {name} (profilo ospite locale; l’accesso è offerto dalla piattaforma).
Ancora nessuna voce: sii il primo.
it-IT.No platform leaderboard for this game —: Nessuna classifica della piattaforma per questo gioco: solo record personali.
it-IT.While you were away your round was pause: Mentre eri via il round era in pausa. Avevi posato {n}/{total} pezzi in {time}.
it-IT.Volumes and mute are in the StarHermit O: Volume e silenzioso si trovano nelle Opzioni di StarHermit.
it-IT.Sound, graphics, language, reduced motio: Suono, grafica, lingua, movimento ridotto, contrasto elevato e testo più grande si trovano nelle Opzioni di StarHermit.
it-IT.With nothing focused, the arrows move a: Senza nulla a fuoco, le frecce spostano un cursore sul tabellone e {place} vi posa il pezzo selezionato (o prende il prossimo pezzo dal vassoio).
it-IT.acct.signInSub: Sincronizza progressi e impostazioni con il tuo account.
it-IT.acct.inviteSub: Copia il tuo link di invito.

en-GB.Sort the tray pieces, read the edge colo: Sort the tray pieces, read the edge colours and glyphs, and drag each piece onto its matching board cell. Pieces snap when legal. Complete connected groups to finish the picture.

es-ES.While you were away your round was pause: Mientras no estabas, tu ronda se ha pausado. Habías colocado {n}/{total} piezas en {time}.
es-ES.acct.signInSub: Sincroniza tu progreso y tus ajustes con tu cuenta.

fr-CA.acct.signInSub: Synchronisez votre progression et vos paramètres avec votre compte.
